Empty invoices retain the configured decimal places. Currency comes from config/company.json. Run python3 -B -m unittest -v checks.test_invoice from the repository root. Standard library only.
import unittest
from billing.service import invoice
from checks.support import example

class InvoiceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_positive_tie(self):
        self.assertEqual(invoice(example('positive')), {'currency': 'USD', 'total': '1.01'})

    def test_negative_tie(self):
        self.assertEqual(invoice(example('negative')), {'currency': 'USD', 'total': '-1.01'})

    def test_sum_before_rounding(self):
        self.assertEqual(invoice(example('combined')), {'currency': 'USD', 'total': '2.01'})

    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(invoice([]), {'currency': 'USD', 'total': '0.00'})

import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=root)
files = git('ls-files').decode().splitlines()
def digest(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
original = {f:digest(root/f) for f in files}
head = git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()
parent = git('rev-parse','HEAD"'^'"').decode().strip()
work = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.invoice-verification-', dir=root))
probe = '''import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
import billing.money as money
import billing.service as service
import checks.test_invoice as tests
import checks.support as support
def identity(module):
    p = Path(module.__file__).resolve()
    data = p.read_bytes()
    return {'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'git_blob':hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\\\\0'+data).hexdigest()}
print(json.dumps({'modules':{m.__name__:identity(m) for m in (money,service,tests,support)}, 'config':json.loads(Path('config/company.json').read_text()), 'results':{name:service.invoice(support.example(name)) for name in ('positive','negative','combined')} | {'empty':service.invoice([])}}, indent=2))
'''
report = {'fixed_commit':head,'previous_commit':parent,'runner':['python3','-B','-m','unittest','-v','checks.test_invoice'],'runs':{}}
for label, revision in [('fixed',head),('previous',parent)]:
    copy = work/label
    for f in files:
        target=copy/f
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(root/f,target)
    for f in files:
        if f.startswith('billing/'):
            (copy/f).write_bytes(git('show', revision+':'+f))
    controlled = {f:digest(copy/f) for f in files if not f.startswith('billing/')}
    assert all(original[f]==value for f,value in controlled.items())
    run = subprocess.run(report['runner'], cwd=copy, text=True, capture_output=True)
    (work/(label+'-tests.log')).write_text(run.stdout+run.stderr)
    actual = subprocess.run(['python3','-B','-c',probe], cwd=copy,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
    loaded = json.loads(actual.stdout)
    for module, info in loaded['modules'].items():
        assert pathlib.Path(info['path']).is_relative_to(copy)
        rel = pathlib.Path(info['path']).relative_to(copy).as_posix()
        expected = git('rev-parse',revision+':'+rel).decode().strip() if rel.startswith('billing/') else git('hash-object',str(root/rel)).decode().strip()
        assert info['git_blob'] == expected
    report['runs'][label]={'revision':revision,'cwd':str(copy),'exit_code':run.returncode,'controlled_file_sha256':controlled,'loaded':loaded}
